content.title: Complete purchase with quantity 2 and SAVE25 worked example
content.intent: Prove the explicit worked example path calculates subtotal, discount, tax, and total correctly, shows the discount line, and carries the exact charged amount into confirmation.
content.technique_notes: Applied state / flow for the end-to-end checkout path and equivalence partitioning for a representative valid quantity with a supported promo. Reviewed quantity × promo classes with covering_array at risk-judged strength 3, degraded by the tool to effective strength 2 because only two inputs apply; this path was kept under budget.max_pairs=2 because it covers the PRD’s explicit money example and confirmation outcome.

content.title: Reject quantity outside 1 to 9 in Aurora checkout
content.intent: Prove quantities below 1 and above 9 are not accepted for purchase.
content.technique_notes: Applied boundary value analysis using expand_bva for the stated quantity bounds 1..9, which yielded 0, 1, 2, 8, 9, and 10; kept the out-of-range representatives 0 and 10 as equivalent invalid outcomes in one boundary scenario. Applied negative / error reasoning because the source constrained valid quantity to 1 through 9, and this path was kept under budget.max_pairs=2 because it covers both underflow and overflow enforcement in a revenue flow.
